entries.0c28dc6b8dcc5a0f: This service runs craft events that bring creators and users together in person. It holds "HandMade In Japan Fes'", described as Japan's largest festival of creators, held at Tokyo Big Sight, and "Creema YAMABIKO FES", an outdoor festival combining music and crafts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥166 million.

entries.131a75e06a01e26d: The company explains that in Japan's handmade marketplace market, two major services lead the market: 'Creema' and 'minne,' which is operated by GMO Pepabo, Inc. The total transaction value of 'Creema' in the marketplace for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥14.87 billion, and the company positions this as having further strengthened its status as Japan's largest handmade marketplace. Revenue is centered on the Marketplace Service, which accounted for ¥1,455 million of revenue of ¥2,535 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026.

entries.32ca33bbd762cb31: A company that offers services supporting creators' creative activities, centered on "Creema," a handmade marketplace.
entries.3a2ff5297b98d8dd: This service provides marketing support for creators, companies and local governments that open shops, using the platform and user base of "Creema". It offers external advertising for companies and local governments as clients, in-house advertising for creators called "Work Promotion", the subscription-type "Creator Push", and the "Speed Transfer Service" for members, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥716 million.
entries.3daef4a702779b98: This is a service operating "Creema," a CtoC handmade marketplace where creators list their own works and users can purchase them. Approximately 310,000 creators have shops on it. In January 2024 it released "InFRAME," an online shop opening service that can be linked with "Creema," and in August 2025 it began a gift catalog service. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥1,455 million.
entries.45d5358ac3f9b3ff: A group of services supporting creators
entries.4e80f2714334c310: This is a group of new services that support creators' creative activities. It provides the crowdfunding service "Creema SPRINGS", through which creators and manufacturers can raise funds for projects, and the lesson video platform "FANTIST", operated by consolidated subsidiary FANTIST Inc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥196 million.

entries.7d6a7e502fefb16b: A service that operates "Creema", a CtoC handmade marketplace where creators list their own works and users can purchase them.
entries.7d979a467187f8df: Under its corporate philosophy, 'Let's create an era that is round and big,' the company has built a model of steadily expanding the number of creators and users on the basis of the Marketplace Service, while also expanding revenue in peripheral areas such as the Platform Service, Event Service and crowdfunding service. With the quality improvement of the Marketplace Service, the foundation of the business, as its top priority, the company is pursuing business diversification that makes use of synergies and advancing the establishment of the Creema economic zone by investing the tangible and intangible assets accumulated there into its new service group.
entries.8ccaf446a86e7f72: Sales commissions on works sold on “Creema”
entries.9a79fedbf8371dee: It is a business model that earns revenue from sales commissions when users purchase works listed by creators, as well as fees for advertising services, membership services and events.
entries.a05a466937cb6d27: CREEMA LTD. is headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with two consolidated subsidiaries: Kelima Gufen Youxian Gongsi in Taiwan and FANTIST Co., Ltd.
entries.a5ecd49e797cd651: This is a group of new services that support creators' creative activities.
entries.a64dd7246f27ee4a: Its distinctiveness lies in a community that has formed around creators who work as artists professionally and creators aspiring to become professionals, and in the fact that this draws many high-quality works, which enables stable attraction of consumers (users) seeking high-quality works. The company began in 2010 as Japan's first handmade marketplace and has built up the accumulated advantage of a pioneer; registered works total about 21.49 million, and cumulative downloads of its smartphone app have reached about 16.15 million.

entries.bb3d8c578dd289fd: This is a single-segment business of the company group, which consists of the company, one domestic subsidiary and one overseas subsidiary, a total of three companies. It provides a venue where creators engaged in creative activities and consumers (users) can buy and sell original works directly online, and supports creators' activities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,535 million.
